meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会获取当前分支 PR 的 Qodo 审查问题，以表格列出；你可选择逐条处理或一键自动修复，它会按 Qodo 建议改代码、提交、回复每条评论并推送。
howto.when: 当你说“qodo review”“resolve pr”等指令，或要求查看或修复 Qodo 审查意见时触发。

say.text: 查看 Qodo 对当前分支 PR 的审查意见
say.note: Claude 会获取并显示问题列表。

say.text: 逐条处理 Qodo 指出的问题
say.note: Claude 会一条条给你看并询问怎么改。

say.text: 自动修复 Qodo 的所有问题
say.note: Claude 会批量应用修复并提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches Qodo review issues for the current PR, displays them in a table, lets you review each or auto-fix all, then applies fixes, commits, replies to comments, and pushes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'qodo review', 'resolve pr', or ask to view/fix Qodo review issues.

say_en.text: Show Qodo review issues for the current PR
say_en.note: Claude fetches and lists the issues.

say_en.text: Walk through Qodo issues one by one
say_en.note: Claude asks how to handle each.
